svg:
Trekking app ER diagram Entity-relationship diagram showing users, staff_profiles, treks, and bookings tables with their fields and relationships
users
PK user_id : int
username : string email : string password : string full_name : string role : string active : bool created_at : datetime
staff_profiles
PK,FK staff_id : int
status : string → users.user_id → treks (one-to-many)
treks
PK trek_id : int
trek_name : string location : string difficulty : string duration : int available_slots : int FK assigned_staff_id : int status : string price : float start_date / end_date
bookings
PK booking_id : int
FK user_id : int FK trek_id : int booking_date : datetime status : string → users.user_id → treks.trek_id
1 : 1
(many) treks: vertical line from staff_profiles bottom to treks top -->
1 : N
(many) bookings: vertical line from users to bookings -->
1 : N
(many) bookings: L-bend from treks left edge to bookings right edge -->
1 : N
Legend:
One-to-one
One-to-many PK = Primary Key FK = Foreign Key PK,FK = both
